D/ [----]NVS AVG ; R/ BEATA TRAN QVILLITAS

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constantine I (306-337), Beata Tran-quillitas issue of Trier mint, 321-323, Reece period 16. Chipped. Obverse description: Helmeted and cuirassed bust right. Obverse inscription: [----]NVS AVG. Reverse description: Globe on altar inscribed VOT/IS/XX, three stars above. Reverse inscription: BEATA TRAN QVILLITAS. In exergue: STR. Diameter: 18.1mm, Weight: 1.62gms, die…
